courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: Now that we are all on the same page regarding Angular again,
let's finally dive into Ionic and here with Ionic, since you learned that Ionic actually stands for a
also the company which is developing capacitor but here with Ionic, I really mean that suite of web components
which is the heart of Ionic and which is what you use in every Ionic app, which turns your app into something
you could call an Ionic app after all.
So in this module, we will have a look at these Ionic components,
I'll give you a thorough overview of how to use them, how to configure them, how to compose beautiful user
interfaces with them, we'll dive into a lot of component demos for that and build a tiny sample application,
web application here not a mobile app yet, we'll do this later but a dummy web application where we use
a couple of Ionic components. And since we have so many Ionic components, I want to help you memorize
them or maybe I can even show you a better way of learning about them and understanding when to use
which component. By the end of this module, this will be much clearer.
